source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: You gain 1CP on a D6 roll of 4+, rolled whenever you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem; the roll gets +1 if that unit is **BATTLELINE**. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

effects.trigger: a Stratagem you use picks the bearer's unit

modifier.if: the bearer's unit has the BATTLELINE keyword

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Bastion Task Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
